regime.note: On September 16 the FOMC raised the federal-funds target range by 25 basis points to 3.75%–4.00%, said economic activity was expanding at a solid pace, and said inflation remained elevated. Low confidence and 64% cash reflect that tighter backdrop plus the analyst book's persistent negative alpha.

thesis: The September 29 rebalance exited CRM and BAC after their catalysts failed to validate the thesis. Through the September 30 settled close, VRTX and NEM remain explicit pre-event positions: Vertex's November 2 earnings precede the November 30 povetacicept PDUFA decision, while Newmont reports October 22. Keep the book unchanged after a single session rather than manufacture churn. Do not add the strongest screen leaders: MRNA rose 141.4% over 60 sessions with RSI 79.2, and TSM is only 0.2% below its prior 20-day high after a 10.2% 20-session rise. The September Fed hike and -17.0 points of all-time alpha justify 64% cash. This is the project's paper-portfolio bridge, not an official plugin investment recommendation.
